name: ossuary
description: The Ossuary as Logan Wolf went through it, played by the user on 2026-10-28: two visits in capture 20261028_165135 (17:13:43-17:26:28 levels 1-3, 17:32:01-17:37:37 levels 1-2; pets GraveRobber and AlaFlambe) and one in 20261028_182147 (20:34:27-21:03:36 levels 1-4; AlaFlambe and Bussin). The tome row 'Ossuary' lands outside at (1213, 2816); the entrance (1205, 2816-2817) takes one to level 1 at (5927, 1316). Levels by a map flood fill (pathfind.Walk from each arrival; all of Logan's steps there walk on the map): level 1 x 5785-5935, y 1270-1381 (9,259 tiles; 141 s there, walked through); level 2 x 5581-5689, y 1225-1363 (6,668; 831 s); level 3 x 5527-5739, y 950-1156 (11,364; 1,355 s), the hunting level by default; level 4 x 4825-5000, y 1744-2073 (21,141; 322 s), in another part of the map, by the strip (5588-5590, 985) at level 3's north end. Merged at load time with ossuary_kb.json (wiki stats, sim/kb_scan.py, plus 5 hand entries) and ossuary_observed.json (sim/calibrate.py --scenario ossuary).

spawn_note: one spawn per cluster of a type's first sightings in the three visits (sim/calibrate.py's Session first sightings of creatures with notoriety 3-5; sightings of a type within 5 tiles merged, the earliest kept): level 1 40, level 2 52, level 3 107, level 4 15. Two days' play, not the Mausoleum's 41-visit check; most first sightings came at 16-18 tiles (the view's edge), so a spawn point is where it stood then. Left out: the summons (spirit asps at an apophite spirit's death, plague frogs, pocket beetles: specials), the ostards (6, each first seen 3-8 tiles from Logan beside ossuarian hunters and huntresses and dead soon after, no gold: dismounted riders' mounts [INFERENCE]), other players' pets (a phoenix, notoriety 1-2), the mummified remains (level 4, one, no wiki row)

phantasm.note: '*laments*' 28 times, 15.17 s apart per phantasm (p10-p90 15.05-15.35); 0.8-2.2 s later (median 1.48) a number on each of us out to 12 tiles with no monster beside the victim: hit 38 of 53 at 6-12 tiles, none of 19 at 13-18 (2 of 7 at 3-5, where melee numbers hide it; [INFERENCE] the same chance there). Pets 26-31 (median 28, n=24, on GraveRobber, AlaFlambe, Bussin), Logan 26-33 (median 32, n=16)

spectral terror.note: '*terrifies*' 8 times, 7.80-8.22 s apart; 1.2-1.9 s later (median 1.67) a number on each of us out to 11 tiles: 12 of 14 at 7-11, 0 of 7 at 13-18 (1 of 2 at 5-6). Pets 55-56 (n=8: AlaFlambe, Bussin), Logan 37-46 (n=4). Any fear effect isn't modelled

hierarch.note: '*channels ancient fire*' 22 times, 7.61-8.01 s apart; from 0.6-1.3 s after it a number every 0.50 s on its target, 5-7 of them (to ~3.8 s), 12-20 (mostly 15-18) on GraveRobber, AlaFlambe and Bussin at 2-11 tiles; sometimes a second victim beside the first; Logan's two (13, 12) the same size. Its melee numbers in the capture are these ticks (swing period 0.55 s), so the type keeps the default swing

jackal spirit.note: '*ritual strike*' 17 times, 7.54-11.07 s apart; 0.73-0.80 s later a hit on the pet beside it, 12 of 17: 29-53 (48 seven times, 53 four), its plain swings 12-77 (median 26). None on Logan seen: his numbers the pets' [INFERENCE]

ossuarian executioner.note: '*prepares execution*' 8 times, 7.58-8.06 s apart (one 24 s); 2.01-2.04 s later a hit on the pet beside it, 5 of 8: 29, 32, 48, 48, 48. None on Logan seen [INFERENCE: the pets' numbers]

bleed.text: A rain of deadly strikes hit you, causing you to bleed!

ossuarian deathbringer.note: '*begins rain of death*' twice (17:23:21.5, 17:23:30.0, 8.44 s apart); 2.25-2.28 s later a number on each of us within 4 tiles (GraveRobber at 1: 20, 25; Logan at 3: 35, 'A rain of deadly strikes hit you, causing you to bleed!'), then Logan 12 every 3.0 s five times ('You are no longer bleeding.' 15.0 s after) and GraveRobber 8s 3.0 s apart. n=2: radius 4 [INFERENCE]

khamsin.note: '*charges*' 6 times, 7.51-8.11 s apart; a hit 0.53-0.54 s later on AlaFlambe beside its landing (32, 35; 2 of 6, the others out of view or blocked); range and targets the wiki Charge's (knowledge #14625) [INFERENCE]

rag witch.note: '*dematerializes*' when hurt (5 times), '*evasive*' 1.5 s later, '*materializes*' 6.4-6.8 s after it (n=3), again 8.4-18.0 s after the last; the jump the banshee's [INFERENCE]

apophite spirit.note: patch 2020-11-21 (knowledge #7925): 'Apophite Spirits when killed will spawn Spirit Asps, however they will now die 5-10 seconds later and not generate loot'; live 5 at each of its 3 deaths in view (20:51:04, 21:01:30, 21:02:03), within 3 tiles of it, gone 2.4-10.3 s later, no emote

brood beetle.note: level 4: pocket beetles first seen beside the brood beetles 2.3-2.8 s apart (20:52:47-20:52:52, three) and 6-36 s apart later (20:58:02-20:58:44, four); up to 3 up at once [INFERENCE]; no emote over either (live)

ossuarian plaguecaller.note: level 4: plague frogs first seen within 9 tiles of the plaguecaller every 3.1-6.9 s (10 in 38 s, 20:55:21-20:55:58), none killed; no emote over either (live)

specials.note: measured 2026-10-28 from the two captures (docs/SIM.md 'The Ossuary'): each emote's period per creature and the numbers on our side after it with no other monster beside the victim. Not modelled (seen, numbers unclear or no mechanic): the anubite's '*exhales*' ('You have been struck by an ancient blight!', 8, 7.7 s apart), the ossuarian huntress's and hunter's '*readies net*' (12, ~16 s apart: '*entangled*' over the pets, 'You have been entangled in a net!'), the ossuarian lion warrior's '*parries spell*' (12: the pets' spells), the ossuarian firebrand's '*ignites*' (8, 15.9 s apart), the ossuarian embalmer's '*prepares mixture*' (6, 16.4 s apart), the ossuarian discguard's disc ('A razor-sharp disc cuts and causes you to bleed!', level 4), and the wiki's tamed-version abilities (kb specials)

ossuarian sightless seer.note: '*plumbs the darkness*' 28 times, 8.24 s apart (p10-p90 7.78-9.32); 1.01-1.05 s later one number on 1-2 of us out to 12 tiles, beside it or not: the pets 31-56 (median 35, n=10; with no monster beside them), Logan 24-26 (n=3); patch 2020-05-12 (knowledge #8441): its area hits at most 2 targets. chance 0.8 [INFERENCE: of the 1-2 within reach most took one]
